title: Paleo Extension
description: STAC Paleo Extension for STAC Items, mapping model time to geological time for paleoclimate simulations.

paleo:year.title: Geological year
paleo:year.description: Geological year the simulation represents (negative = past, e.g. -21000 for LGM).

paleo:display.title: Human-readable geological time
paleo:display.description: Formatted geological time, e.g. '22.0 ka', '66.0 Ma', '500 BCE'.

paleo:reference_year.title: Reference year
paleo:reference_year.description: Reference year used for the 'years ago' calculation in paleo:display.

paleo:years_bp.title: Years before present
paleo:years_bp.description: Years before present (present = 1950 CE). Only set for experiment_type 'paleo'.
